meta.name: seo-content-product-page
meta.description: Optimize e-commerce product pages (PDPs) for Google and for AI assistants that now recommend products directly. Input: a product page or description (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, Wix, Webflow, or custom). Output: a rewritten PDP with unique copy, FAQ and definition blocks, review and real-photo rules, title/H1/slug/meta, out-of-stock handling, Product schema, and ChatGPT Shopping feed notes. Use to write, rewrite, or audit a product page, or when PDPs get no traffic or traffic without sales.
